Phương thức vận chuyển bằng đường bộ chủ.en: The road transport method used mainly trucking trucks, container cars, cranes, trailers... for freight. Depending on the needs of customers, the goods specifications choose the right medium. The flexibility, the engine is the greatest advantage of this method of transportation. Also the procedure is simple, easy, quick, save time for customers.
Phương thức vận chuyển bằng đường bộ chủ.zh: 公路运输方法主要采用卡车,集装箱车,起重机,拖车等运输方式. 根据客户的需要,商品规格选择正确的介质. 灵活性,发动机是这种运输方法的最大优势. 程序也简单,简单,快捷,为顾客节省时间.

Phương tiện di chuyển bằng tàu hỏa chỉ c.en: Train transport only runs on the fixed railway line. So without having to share the route with other vehicles, the time for rapid transport was less affected by the accident factors, traffic jams... heavy goods, Mohammad, too trainloading all easily including the distance.
Phương tiện di chuyển bằng tàu hỏa chỉ c.zh: 列车运输仅在固定铁路线上行驶. 因此,不用与其他车辆共用路线,快速运输的时间 受事故因素的影响较小 交通堵塞... 重型货物,穆罕默德,太 列车装载所有容易 包括距离。

Quy trình vận chuyển nghiêm ngặt, tuân t.en: The transport process is strict, conforming to regulations, making sure that the freight is on time as committed.
Quy trình vận chuyển nghiêm ngặt, tuân t.zh: 运输过程严格,符合规定,确保运费按时到位。
